title: I made a mobile game RPG where your steps in real life turn into energy in game. Looking for testers
author: RXLGames
selftext:
I'm a solo dev.

Client: Unity 6 (6000.5.4f1), C#, uGUI built entirely in code with no prefab screens

Steps come from Health Connect on Android and HealthKit on iOS.

Backend: [ASP.NET](http://ASP.NET) Core on .NET 8, Postgres via Npgsql, Redis for matchmaking, running on DigitalOcean

Art is gpt-image. Generated from my prompts on chroma green, snapped to the pixel grid, keyed, then hand-edited.

Code is written with Claude Code.  I use Fable to plan and review and Opus5 does majority of the implementation. 

Happy to go into any layer of that. Links in the comments.

comments.author: RXLGames
comments.body:
Hi everyone,

This is a closed beta so you will need to do the following depending if you're Android or iOS.  
  
Android:

1. Join [https://groups.google.com/g/aetherstep-testers](https://groups.google.com/g/aetherstep-testers) using the Google accountyour phone's Play Store is signed into.
2. Then open [https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.aetherstep.game](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.aetherstep.game) on that sameaccount and hit "Become a tester". Give it ten minutes to propagate.

iOS: [https://testflight.apple.com/join/PsXU9psv](https://testflight.apple.com/join/PsXU9psv)

comments.author: taller_than_peanut
comments.body:
cool idea. kind of like those Nintendo games (Pokemon Go, Monster Hunter Wild, Pikmin Bloom)

does it require location data to work? I'd be skeptic in letting an unknown dev have access to some of my data

replies.author: RXLGames
replies.body: no location data involved. everything is connected through the health app to track your steps

comments.author: Alzeric
comments.body: You're not gonna trick me into exercising!

comments.author: hereforfunntbh
comments.body: Awesome idea but how will you monetize it?

replies.author: RXLGames
replies.body: Currently there is a battlepass that lets you pay for conveniences like having more listings in the market or ability to skip the dungeon simulation. There is also lootboxes for cosmetics.
